The '''Bombing of the Senate Tower''' was an act of terrorism that occurred on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]]&mdash;just days after the end of the [[Great Galactic War]]. The bombing was orchestrated by the rogue [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dar'Nala]] in an attempt to entice the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the Republic to blame the attack on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and restart the war. The bombing also unintentionally destroyed the classified project files for the scrapped prototype [[Hammer Station]] weapon.
